# Bid the pallets, the dirt, and the extra work.

> Price a sod install from fescue, bermuda, or zoysia: lawn size, whole pallets, soil prep, delivery, slope, and watering — plus the walk-away price a $0.55-a-foot special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
